title: City Council District 2
statement: As we verify the first soil test results for the Baylight District project, I emphasize the need for transparency and community engagement. The data must guide our decisions, ensuring the project's success benefits the entire community, particularly Jack London and Downtown Oakland. I will closely monitor the independent oversight and site remediation progress, prioritizing the economic momentum and public safety in these areas.

payload.text: I understand the concern about Grand Lake's neighborhood math-imbalance flag, but as the representative of District 2, my primary focus is on the Baylight District project and its impact on Jack London and Downtown Oakland. I will consider targeted commercial stabilization measures for Grand Lake in future proposals, but for now, my priority is ensuring the Baylight District project's success.
